Honestly, it depends a lot on the size, the finishes you choose and the condition of the site, so any number without seeing it would be a guess. We do a site visit first and then share an itemised quotation, so you can see exactly where the money goes. Which area is the project in?

Two spaces that look similar can cost very differently once services, materials and joinery are counted. That is why we price from an itemised bill of quantities after seeing the site. What kind of space is it, and roughly how big?

We design and build kitchens, wardrobes and custom furniture to the drawing, so what you approve in 3D is what gets made. If you can share the room size and a photo, a designer can suggest a layout. Which city are you in?
Good choice to plan it properly. For kitchens and wardrobes the layout and hardware decide how well it works every day, more than the finish. Is this for a new house or replacing what you have?

That is the kind of project we do a lot of. For commercial spaces the layout, lighting and services matter more than the finishes, so we always start with a site visit. How big is the space, and when would you like it ready?

Nice. With offices and shops, getting the planning right first saves a lot of rework later, things like seating flow, power points and air-conditioning. Where is the space, and is it a shell or already fitted out?
Renovations go much smoother when the house is surveyed before any finishes are chosen, since wiring, plumbing and damp often decide the plan. Is it the whole house or a few rooms?
Happy to help. With renovations we check the services and structure first, then plan finishes, so there are no surprises halfway. Which rooms are you thinking of changing?
Lovely. For homes we start with how your family actually uses each room, then build the design and 3D views around that. Which area is the house in, and is it new or already lived in?
Homes are a big part of what we do. A short brief on how many rooms and the look you like helps a designer prepare. Where is the house?

It depends on the size and how much is being built, so the team gives you a written programme with the quotation after the site visit. If you have a date in mind, tell me and the designer will plan around it.
We share a clear programme, stage by stage, once the scope is agreed, so you know what happens each week. Do you have a target date?
You can see a selection of our completed spaces on the Projects page of this website. If you tell me the kind of space you are planning, a designer can share similar work with you.
Our Projects page has homes, offices and commercial spaces we have delivered. What type of space are you planning? I can point you to the closest examples.
Our in-house 3D studio prepares the views, so you can see the space properly before anything is built and make changes on screen rather than on site. What space would you like to visualise?
